record.question: List out which one is not the protocol for destroying medical records:
options: Identify the records to be destroyed
record.explanation: Answer D: None of the above. Identifying records for destruction, obtaining approval, and documenting which records were destroyed are all elements of controlled records disposition; therefore none is an exception. Reference: https://www.archives.gov/records-mgmt/scheduling. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
